text:
Predicates:
BakedSweet(x) ::: x is a baked sweet.
Spicy(x) ::: x is spicy.
Cupcake(x) ::: x is a cupcake.
MalaHotpot(x) ::: x is a mala hotpot.
ProductBakedByMelissa(x) ::: x is a product from Baked by Melissa.
FOL ::: Dried Thai chilies are cupcakes and products of Baked by Melissa.
Premises:
∀x (BakedSweet(x) → ¬Spicy(x)) ::: No baked sweets are spicy.
∀x (Cupcake(x) → BakedSweet(x)) ::: All cupcakes are baked sweets.
∀x (MalaHotpot(x) → Spicy(x)) ::: All mala hotpots are spicy.
∀x (ProductBakedByMelissa(x) → Cupcake(x)) ::: All products from Baked by Melissa are cupcakes.
Spicy(driedThaiChilies) ∨ MalaHotpot(driedThaiChilies) ∨ ¬BakedSweet(driedThaiChilies) ::: Dried Thai chilies are spicy or mala hotpots or not baked sweets.
Conclusion:
Cupcake(driedThaiChilies) ∧ ProductBakedByMelissa(driedThaiChilies) ::: Dried Thai chilies are cupcakes and products of Baked by Melissa.
